subject.title: feat(agents)!: remove the stored default agent — sole agent or explicit ownership

question: Should OpenClaw adopt fail-closed explicit ownership for all newly unowned multi-agent ambient work while retaining a first-agent legacy Gateway projection for older clients during rolling upgrades?
rationale: This is a user-visible ownership and compatibility policy choice spanning persisted configuration, scheduled work, sessions, credentials, and protocol consumers; code review alone cannot decide the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve the explicit-ownership transition
options.body: Accept fail-closed multi-agent ambient ownership after migration and retain the documented legacy Gateway projection for rolling upgrades.

options.title: Preserve a configurable compatibility fallback
options.body: Keep existing ambient default behavior unless users explicitly opt into strict ownership, at the cost of retaining an additional compatibility mode.

options.title: Pause for a narrower migration design
options.body: Defer default retirement until protocol clients and persisted-job upgrade behavior can be simplified or independently versioned.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit-ownership transition
recommendation.body: Accept fail-closed multi-agent ambient ownership after migration and retain the documented legacy Gateway projection for rolling upgrades.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the merged ownership groundwork and the current cross-surface transition design.
